title: Local TV ad cost: broadcast, cable and streaming

facts.fact: Local TV ad cost usually runs from a few hundred dollars to several thousand dollars per airing, according to 2026 guidance from Comcast Advertising and National Media Spots; production is a separate cost.
facts.value: a few hundred to several thousand dollars
facts.quote: A local TV ad cost usually runs from a few hundred dollars to several thousand per airing.

facts.fact: National Media Spots gives a local broadcast TV range of $500 to $10,000 per month.
facts.quote: Local broadcast TV | $500 to $10,000 | Per month

facts.fact: National Media Spots gives a regional cable TV range of $1,000 to $20,000 per month.
facts.quote: Regional cable TV | $1,000 to $20,000 | Per month

facts.fact: National Media Spots gives a streaming/CTV range of $500 to $50,000+ per month.
National Media Spots gives a streaming/CTV price range of $15 to $40+ CPM.
Amazon Ads gives a TV 30-second spot price range of $5 to $30 CPM; the page does not state the date.
facts.quote: TV, 30-second spot | $5 to $30 | CPM | Amazon Ads

facts.fact: Reported via NBC and Bloomberg, a Super Bowl 30-second spot averaged about $8 million for airtime only, with some above $10 million.
facts.value: about $8 million average, some above $10 million
facts.quote: About $8 million average, some above $10 million

facts.fact: Moonb's 2026 guide puts a simple local TV spot production at $1,500 to $10,000.
facts.quote: Moonb’s 2026 guide puts a simple local spot at $1,500 to $10,000 for production.

facts.fact: The page says professional mid-range TV commercial production runs $10,000 to $50,000.
National Media Spots notes that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.
facts.quote: National Media Spots notes that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.

facts.fact: Local broadcast time is priced by multiplying the SQAD cost per point for the market by the Nielsen rating of the program airing at that time.
facts.quote: take the SQAD cost per point for the market and multiply it by the Nielsen rating of the program airing at that time.

facts.fact: BIA's September 2026 update puts 2026 local political spending at $9.7 billion, up from $8.4 billion in April.
facts.quote: local political spending at $9.7 billion for 2026, up from $8.4 billion in April

facts.fact: BIA says $1.2 billion of the $1.3 billion increase in local political spending went to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming).
facts.quote: BIA says $1.2 billion went to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming).

facts.fact: BIA's first look at 2027 has local political spending falling to about $1.1 billion, with total local revenue roughly flat at $186.5 billion.
facts.quote: political spending falling to about $1.1 billion in the off-cycle year, with total local revenue roughly flat at $186.5 billion

facts.fact: Adwave pricing allows daily budgets from $30 to $10,000, prepaid, with no subscription or contract, and campaign creative is included.
facts.quote: Adwave pricing allows [daily budgets from $30 to $10,000](https://adwave.com/pricing/), prepaid, with no subscription or contract, and campaign creative is included.

facts.fact: Per Adwave, TV, Facebook, Instagram and Google (YouTube and Search) channels open from a $30 daily budget.
facts.quote: TV, Facebook, Instagram and Google (YouTube and Search) open from $30 a day.

facts.fact: Per Adwave, Reddit opens from about a $35 daily budget.
facts.quote: Reddit opens from about $35 a day.

facts.fact: Per Adwave, extra creative beyond the included set costs $12 per additional 30-second TV spot.
facts.quote: Extra creative beyond the included set has its own price, for example $12 per additional 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing is prepaid with no subscription or contract required.
facts.quote: prepaid, with no subscription or contract, and campaign creative is included.
